title: How far a child's vaccination record can be trusted
description: The ordered states of the record along the journeys, from signed paper to shared and audited abroad. Each state includes the ones before it.

codes.label: On paper
codes.definition: Signed cards in the family's hands.

codes.label: Verified
codes.definition: Signature checked against the WHO trust list.

codes.label: Portable
codes.definition: A full summary the family can share.

codes.label: Shared and audited
codes.definition: Viewed abroad, and every access logged at home.
